body:
## [3.95.0] - 2026-10-12

### Features

- add configurable customer city to NEXO POS
- Implement receipt delivery service with SMS and email support
- add employee PIN settings access feature

### Bug Fixes

- update checkout payload test to preserve all terminal card details
- restore card details for desktop fast credit
- preserve unknown city when editing restored customers
- guard city migration on legacy settings table
- preserve customer city across quick add and cache upgrades
- persist quotation cancellation before remote release
- guard quotation customer edits and isolate history search
- respect settlement currency precision and reject negative linked quantities
- render quotation receipts with frontend font asset
- preserve additional barcode search
- harden device data recovery
- allow terminal reconciliation to complete
- serialize product search filtering
- cancel timed out Shva terminal requests
- keep register close guarded during Shva report
- keep POS recovery paths responsive

### Other Changes

- Enhance quotation save and print functionality with customer selection and metadata synchronization
- Add unit tests for quotation pricing, saving, and printing functionality
- Add encrypted device recovery collection
- Fixed the flaky test. The token’s timestamp accidentally contained 812, triggering an incorrect failure.
- update kiosk settings authentication fixtures (AION-407)
